name: Can Drainage Problems Be Fixed With Foundation Repair?

mainEntity.name: Can a foundation repair contractor also fix drainage problems?
mainEntity.text: Can a foundation repair contractor also fix drainage problems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drainage and foundation repair are closely connected. If water is pooling near the foundation, running toward the house, or saturating the soil, any structural repair may be undermined over time. Many contractors offer drainage solutions such as grading correction, downspout extensions, French drains, and surface runoff control. The important question is whether the contractor is fixing drainage as part of the structural diagnosis or simply adding it as an upsell. In Los Angeles County, where soil conditions and topography can vary significantly, controlling water around the structure is often essential to long-term performance. Ask whether the drainage work is intended to prevent recurring movement and whether it should be completed before or after the structural repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, many foundation repair contractors also handle drainage corrections because water is a major cause of soil movement and settlement. Downspouts, grading, French drains, sump systems, and surface runoff control can all reduce future foundation damage. In Los Angeles County, drainage should be evaluated alongside the foundation so the repair does not fail again.
